title: Exclusive-Intel, AMD sign long-term server CPU deals with Chinese clients as prices surge, sources say
title_zh: 独家消息：消息人士称，随着价格飙升，英特尔、AMD 与中国客户签署长期服务器 CPU 协议
summary: U.S. chipmaking giants Intel and Advanced Micro Devices are signing longer-term purchase commitments with Chinese server customers for data-centre processors as prices ‌surge, two people familiar with the talks said.
summary_zh: 两位知情人士表示，随着价格飙升，美国芯片制造巨头英特尔和 Advanced Micro Devices 正在与中国服务器客户签署数据中心处理器的长期采购承诺。

title: Pichai pushes back on claims Google is losing ground in AI race
title_zh: 皮查伊反驳谷歌在人工智能竞赛中节节败退的说法
summary: Alphabet CEO Sundar Pichai used Wednesday's earnings call to mount a robust defence of Google's AI strategy, pushing back on concerns that the company has fallen behind rivals after ‌delaying a flagship model and ceding ground in AI coding.
summary_zh: Alphabet 首席执行官桑达尔·皮查伊 (Sundar Pichai) 在周三的财报电话会议上对谷歌的人工智能战略进行了强有力的辩护，反驳了人们对该公司在推迟旗舰模型和在人工智能编码领域让步后落后于竞争对手的担忧。

title: Musk keeps Tesla-SpaceX merger speculation alive, cites growing overlap
title_zh: 马斯克称特斯拉与 SpaceX 合并的猜测不断增加，重叠日益增多
summary: Tesla CEO Elon Musk on Wednesday left the door open to the EV maker merging with his other trillion-dollar-plus-valued firm SpaceX, declining to ‌dismiss the possibility and citing growing overlap between the companies.
summary_zh: 周三，特斯拉首席执行官埃隆·马斯克(Elon Musk)为这家电动汽车制造商与他的另一家价值数万亿美元以上的公司 SpaceX 合并敞开了大门，他拒绝否认这种可能性，并指出两家公司之间的重叠越来越大。

title: Tesla-SpaceX merger? Musk cites 'more and more overlap'
title_zh: 特斯拉与 SpaceX 合并？马斯克称“重叠越来越多”
summary: Elon Musk addresses shareholder questions about a potential merger between Tesla (TSLA) and SpaceX (SPCX), noting their growing operational overlap before deferring to Tesla's General Counsel, who highlights their strategic partnership and joint work on initiatives like Terafa...
summary_zh: 埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 回答了股东有关特斯拉 (TSLA) 和 SpaceX (SPCX) 潜在合并的问题，指出两家公司的业务重叠日益增多，然后才听从特斯拉总法律顾问的意见，总法律顾问强调了他们的战略合作伙伴关系以及在 Terafa 等举措上的联合工作……

title: S&P 500, Nasdaq close lower ahead of technology earnings
title_zh: 标准普尔 500 指数和纳斯达克指数在科技财报公布前收低

title: Amazon Investigated Over Chinese Influence by US Senate Panel
title_zh: 美国参议院小组调查亚马逊中国影响力

title: Inside Alphabet's earnings call with Google CEO Sundar Pichai
title_zh: Alphabet 与谷歌首席执行官桑达尔·皮查伊 (Sundar Pichai) 举行的财报电话会议
summary: Yahoo Finance brings you inside Alphabet (GOOGL, GOOG) earnings call, led by Google CEO Sundar Pichai. Key takeaways include a 24% year-over-year increase in Alphabet's revenue, 17% growth in Search revenue, and a 13% rise in YouTube advertising revenue.
summary_zh: 雅虎财经为您带来由 Google 首席执行官桑达尔·皮查伊 (Sundar Pichai) 主持的 Alphabet (GOOGL、GOOG) 财报电话会议。主要收获包括 Alphabet 收入同比增长 24%、搜索收入增长 17%、YouTube 广告收入增长 13%。

title: Elon Musk is 'in denial' that Tesla is just an EV company: Ross Gerber
title_zh: 埃隆·马斯克“否认”特斯拉只是一家电动汽车公司：罗斯·格伯
summary: EV maker Tesla (TSLA) released mixed second quarter results after Wednesday's close, reporting adjusted earnings of $0.33 per share (vs. estimates of $0.51) and revenue of $28.24 billion (vs. estimates of $26.32 billion). The stock is sliding in extended hours trading.
summary_zh: 电动汽车制造商特斯拉 (TSLA) 在周三收盘后公布了喜忧参半的第二季度业绩，调整后每股收益为 0.33 美元（预期为 0.51 美元），营收为 282.4 亿美元（预期为 263.2 亿美元）。该股在延长交易时间内下跌。

title: Options strategist reveals how he'd trading Alphabet ahead of earnings
title_zh: 期权策略师透露他将如何在盈利前交易 Alphabet
summary: All-Star Charts chief options strategist Sean McLaughlin joins Josh Lipton on Market Domination to share how he's looking at the earnings, specifically Alphabet (GOOGL), with options in mind.
summary_zh: 全明星图表首席期权策略师肖恩·麦克劳克林 (Sean McLaughlin) 与乔什·利普顿 (Josh Lipton) 一起讨论市场支配地位，分享他如何看待盈利，特别是考虑到期权的 Alphabet (GOOGL)。
